headline: Anthropic's regulatory tensions reshape White House AI strategy
body: Anthropic has become a focal point in the White House's AI policy decisions, creating friction between the administration's push to accelerate AI development and the company's cautious approach. This dynamic matters for healthcare AI because regulatory positioning directly influences how quickly foundation models reach clinical deployment, vendor consolidation patterns, and the compliance frameworks that EHR vendors must navigate. Investors are signaling concerns about Anthropic's post-IPO revenue sustainability, which could affect the availability of capital for healthcare-focused AI development and the competitive landscape for enterprise healthcare solutions. The tension between unbridled innovation and safety-first governance will define which AI vendors dominate clinical workflows over the next 18 months.
